card.line: Rabbah was the main city of the Ammonites, east of the Jordan. David's army besieged it, and later prophets said God would bring it down.

moments.title: Og's iron bed
moments.text: Moses said that the iron bed of Og, king of Bashan and last of the Rephaim, was still in Rabbah of the Ammonites. It was nine cubits long and four cubits wide.

moments.title: Joab besieges Rabbah
moments.text: In the spring, David sent Joab and the whole army of Israel to destroy the Ammonites and besiege Rabbah. David stayed in Jerusalem.

moments.title: David captures the city
moments.text: Joab took the royal fortress and the water supply, then called David to bring the troops. David came, fought against Rabbah, and captured it. He took the king's gold crown and much plunder.

moments.title: Jeremiah's warning
moments.text: The LORD said He would sound the battle cry against Rabbah. It would become a heap of ruins, and its villages would be burned.

moments.title: Ezekiel's warning
moments.text: Because Ammon cheered when Israel was laid waste, the Lord GOD said He would make Rabbah a pasture for camels. Then they would know that He is the LORD.
